in_marathi.name: Mehal
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mehal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Mehal is a name of the Hindu Goddess Mahalaxmi, the goddess of wealth, prosperity, and good fortune. The name Mehal means 'night' and is associated with the moon and the power of the night.
